declarations.description:
A ranked list whose rows carry their own bar, like the top pages, referrers and countries of Vercel Analytics,
Plausible and Stripe, or Tremor's BarList: each row's background is a bar as long as its share of the largest value,
with the label (and an optional icon or link) on it and the value at the end.

Rows are sorted largest first (`sort`), and `max-items` shows only the first rows with a button to show the rest.
`diverging` draws changes instead: bars grow right from a centre line for positive values and left for negative ones,
coloured apart, and the values carry their sign. Values are formatted in the page's language with `value-format`
(`Intl.NumberFormat` options, such as a percent or a currency), or by `valueFormatter`.

A row is a link when it has an `href`. With `interactive`, rows without one are buttons that fire `item-select`, for a
dashboard that filters by the row picked. A screen reader hears a list of rows, each its label and its value.

members.name: items
members.description: The rows. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ label, value, href, icon }`.

members.name: sort
members.description: The order of the rows: largest value first, smallest first, or as given.

members.name: maxItems
members.description: How many rows show before a button reveals the rest. 0 shows them all.

members.name: diverging
members.description: Draws changes: positive bars grow right from a centre line, negative ones left, and values carry their sign.

members.name: valueFormat
members.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for the values, as an object or JSON: `{"style":"percent"}`, `{"style":"currency","currency":"EUR"}`.

members.name: max
members.description: The value the longest bar stands for. Defaults to the largest value (in absolute terms when `diverging`).

members.name: interactive
members.description: Makes the rows without an `href` buttons that fire `item-select`.

members.name: labelHeader
members.description: Title above the labels; with `value-header`, shows a header row.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the list. Defaults to "Ranking" in the page's language.

events.name: item-select
events.description: An `interactive` row was pressed. `index` is its position in `items`.
